title: Integrate governance cost metrics with lifecycle and bottleneck reporting
rawUserRequest: Implement the approved 14-WI AI Cockpit improvement plan in performance-first order. Execute in English low-token mode; preserve separate WIs and keep each WI convergent. This WI must integrate lifecycle-aware governance cost and bottleneck reporting without changing policy decisions.

declaredIntent.summary: Make one Work Item's start-to-close governance cost and measured bottlenecks reusable for later optimization and parallel execution WIs.

outOfScope: Changing gate, scheduling, or governance decisions based on metrics
Provider billing, token-cost estimation, or external telemetry integrations
Outcome dialog delivery, machine status interface, evidence reuse, or parallel execution behavior
Task scheduling, agent assignment, or workflow orchestration

sources.reason: WI-02 evidence-only cost report foundation to extend compatibly.
Canonical local lifecycle and gate event semantics.
Existing top-bottleneck and elapsed-time semantics to make reusable.
Existing evidence-only boundary and unknown semantics.
Archived WI-02 contract records the user-authorized execution-metrics boundary and unknown semantics.

riskAssessment.reason: Lifecycle aggregation must preserve exact observed values, deterministic bottleneck ordering, and advisory-only semantics.

reasons: Governance schema and lifecycle evidence changes require strict verification; report remains advisory-only.

executionDecision.reason: The Contract bounds an evidence-only local lifecycle report and explicitly preserves gate decisions.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A reusable report records start-to-close elapsed time when authoritative lifecycle evidence provides it, while preserving local active/verification/gate phase durations.
CI wait, human wait, and recovery/retry durations are reported only from explicit event evidence; unavailable values remain unknown and are never inferred.
The report ranks deterministic top bottlenecks from observed lifecycle phases, gates, and explicit waits without double-counting a source category.
Execution counts, cross-Work-Item exclusion, malformed-input fail-closed behavior, deterministic digesting, and advisory decisionImpact=none remain intact.
The common JSON schema, focused tests, and human-readable documentation cover complete, partial, empty, and invalid evidence scenarios.
guidelines: Keep metrics evidence-only; never use them to bypass a required check or change scheduling.
Use explicit event durations and represent unavailable categories as unknown.
Keep report output deterministic apart from generatedAt and document the machine-readable and Markdown contracts.

intent.problem: The WI-02 cost report exposes basic counts but does not yet provide a reusable start-to-close lifecycle breakdown or explain which measured phases and gates dominate execution.
constraints: Preserve unknown semantics; never estimate provider usage, human wait, or recovery values.
Do not alter gate outcomes, scheduling behavior, or Work Item lifecycle decisions.
intent.rationale: A compatible lifecycle and bottleneck projection gives WI-11, WI-12, WI-13, and external agents comparable evidence for optimization while keeping the Governance Trust Layer authoritative and advisory metrics separate.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A complete lifecycle log includes start/finish, phases, gates, retries, and explicit waits.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report retains total elapsed, time categories, execution counts, and deterministic top bottlenecks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused deterministic event fixture and CLI report assertions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Provider, human, token, or recovery evidence is absent or has no authoritative duration.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Unavailable categories remain unknown and no proxy duration is emitted.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Malformed or cross-Work-Item evidence is present.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Malformed input fails closed and cross-item events are excluded and counted.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized the complete 14-WI implementation plan, including governance-cost schema integration.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
